Emma - Support: Customer on Dedicated (eu-west1) hitting intermittent 503s and long tail token latency ~2.5s per token since ~2026-03-16T14:22Z. Observed node heartbeat flaps on redwood-gpu-07. Collecting repro info: request ids: req_0b9f3c2a, req_a7d4e11f, req_21f9c000. Can SRE grab node and pod logs + GPU metrics and we’ll produce a curl repro for the customer?

Noah - Support: Pasting a minimal curl that reproduces a 503 for them locally (use their API token). We saw identical behavior hitting /v1/generate with a streaming client.
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-8b","input":"Translate to SQL: select * from users where id=123","max_tokens":256}'
```

Noah - Support: Customer also provided server-side request logs with request id mapping to their side: internal_req: 20260316-44b. They asked for a debug bundle and timeline so they can correlate.

Liam - Eng-SRE: Acknowledged. I’ll start collection for node redwood-gpu-07 and pods in dedicated-tenant-101. Quick checklist I’ll run: node heartbeat timeline, kubelet logs, container logs, nvidia-smi snapshots, dmesg for GPU errors, and DCGM metrics.

Liam - Eng-SRE: Commands I’m running now (sharing so support can reproduce):
```
# pod logs for the inference pod (last 200 lines)
kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-101 logs deploy/inference-service -c runtime --tail=200

# previous terminated container logs
kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-101 logs deploy/inference-service -c runtime -p --tail=200

# describe the node
kubectl describe node redwood-gpu-07

# kernel/GPU errors
sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 | egrep -i "nvrm|gpu|xid|oom"

# nv driver and GPU status
sudo nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,UTILIZATION,POWER
```

Priya - Eng-Runtime: If you can also grab the runtime debug logs with kv-cache traces that would help — set REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 and grab last 5000 lines from /var/log/redwood/runtime.log (rotated logs may be in /var/log/redwood/runtime.log.1). Also capture the KV cache header in the runtime debug output (we log cache-hit/miss per request id).

InfraBot: debug-bundle collect started: id=dbg-20260316-4532, target=node:redwood-gpu-07,pods:inference-service,include:[k8s,systemd,driver,dmetrics]. Estimated size 48MB.

Liam - Eng-SRE: Collected kubelet journal and container logs, attaching snippets below (trimmed):
- kubelet: repeated errors: "heartbeat missed for pod inference-service, reconnecting"
- runtime container: stack traces on send: "write: broken pipe" when flushing to client 
- nvidia dmesg: 'NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79' repeated twice around 14:21:33Z

Noah - Support: Good find on Xid 79. Customer will want the raw dmesg and nvidia-smi output. I triggered the debug collection and shared link: https://internal-debug.redwood/collections/dbg-20260316-4532/download

Priya - Eng-Runtime: Please also grab the runtime binary version and model quantization profile active on that pod:
```
# runtime version and build info (inside pod)
kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-101 exec deploy/inference-service -c runtime -- cat /etc/redwood/version

# env vars
kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-101 exec deploy/inference-service -c runtime -- printenv | egrep 'REDWOOD|KV_CACHE|QUANT'
```

Liam - Eng-SRE: Got runtime v2.9.1-build.182, quant_profile=fp16-slim. Also confirmed DCGM exporter metrics show GPU_UTIL avg spiking to 98% and SM_EFFICIENCY dropping with occasional memory errors.

Liam - Eng-SRE: Uploaded kubelet, pod logs, dmesg, nvidia-smi snapshots to debug bundle dbg-20260316-4532. Files: kubelet.log, inference-runtime.log.1, dmesg.txt, nvidia-smi-20260316-1422.txt, dcgm-metrics.json

Emma - Support: Forwarding bundle link and repro curl to customer now. Noting they want a short summary for PCI compliance: timeline of request ids, node heartbeats, and whether there was driver fault.

Priya - Eng-Runtime: Early hypothesis: driver Xid 79 indicates a GPU recovery; runtime write broken pipe + high util could point to kernel-level driver fault causing sockets to drop. Next steps: repro under load with same model+quant profile and capture dcgm+nv-hostengine traces. If reproable, plan for node replacement and driver upgrade to 535.86.05.

Liam - Eng-SRE: Scheduling repro run tomorrow 08:00 EU-west for isolated dedicated shard. I’ll reserve redwood-gpu-09 as a spare. Will post run id once done.

Noah - Support: Thanks everyone. Marking this thread for follow-up after repro. Customer notified and has the debug bundle link. :thumbsup:
